styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Old Town lanes, world-class museums and the lakefront.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Lake boats, hilltop views and mountain day trips.

stays.why: Right in the old town by the river and lake; walk to most sights. Quiet at night.
Central and handy for the main station and trams; the shopping street on your doorstep.
Lively old-town quarter with bars and cheap eats; good for nightlife and budget stays.
Quiet, leafy area near the lake and museums; a short tram ride to the centre.

food: Try cheese fondue or raclette in an old-town restaurant; portions are big, so share.
Zurich-style sliced veal in cream sauce (Zürcher Geschnetzeltes) is the local classic.
Markthalle im Viadukt under the railway arches has many small food stalls; good for lunch.
Chocolate shops and cafés are everywhere; a hot chocolate is a cheap treat.
Supermarket sandwiches and takeaway are the budget option; restaurant meals cost much more.
more_time: Take a lake boat from Bürkliplatz in summer and stop at a lakeside village for a walk.
Ride the train to Uetliberg hill for a short hike and city views; check the weather first.
Swap a city afternoon for a day trip to Lucerne or the Rhine Falls by train.

recommend.why: Two nights cover the old town, the museums and a lake or hill outing; add a night for a mountain day trip.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 4°C, lows around -2°C. Pack a warm coat and expect about 14 rain days.
Still cold, highs near 7°C. Fewer rain days than January, so outdoor walks are possible.
Mild and changeable: highs near 11°C, lows near 1°C, with about 13 rain days.
Spring warms up: highs near 15°C. Bring a light jacket and an umbrella.
Pleasant but the wettest month: highs near 18°C and about 18 rain days. Keep plans flexible.
Warm start to summer: highs near 23°C, lows near 13°C. Good for lake walks and boat trips.
Warmest month: highs near 25°C. Pack light clothes and sunscreen.
Warm like July, highs near 25°C, with fewer rain days. Great for the lake and hills.
Still mild: highs near 20°C. A good month for walking and day trips.
Cooler and often clear: highs near 15°C. Bring layers for evenings.
Chilly: highs near 9°C, lows near 3°C, with about 13 rain days. A warm jacket is needed.
Cold again: highs near 6°C, lows near 0°C. Expect about 14 rain days; pack rain gear.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate climate with four clear seasons. Summers are warm, winters are cold, and rain is possible in any month.

items.title: Best time: June to September
items.text: Highs around 20–25°C and lows around 11–15°C. Best for the lake, boats and hill walks.

items.title: Winter is cold (December to February)
items.text: Highs around 4–7°C and lows near -2 to 0°C. Pack a warm coat, hat and gloves.

items.title: Rain in every month
items.text: About 12–18 rain days a month. May is the wettest. Always carry a small umbrella.

items.title: Plan indoor backups
items.text: Museums and cafés are good rainy-day options. Check the forecast each morning.

items.title: Big swings between seasons
items.text: From about 4°C in January to 25°C in July. Layers work best in spring and autumn.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Comfortable walking shoes, a waterproof layer and a warm jacket for winter. Light clothes for summer.

transit.best: Trams and S-Bahn trains for almost everything; walking in the centre.

modes.text: No metro. Use trams and S-Bahn trains instead.
Trams and buses cover the centre. Buy and validate tickets before boarding. Single zone 110 tickets cost about CHF 4-5; 24-hour cards about CHF 9-10.
S-Bahn suburban trains link the centre with suburbs and the airport. Fast and frequent.
Uber and Bolt operate; local taxi apps also work. Useful late at night.
Driving is congested and parking is expensive. Public transport is usually faster.
Walking is easy in the centre. Lake boats run from Bürkliplatz in summer.
Lake boats from Bürkliplatz run in summer; a pleasant way to see the lake.
